CHIEF COMPLAINT
Ankle pain and swelling after a fall.

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS
Stephanie Morales is a 36-year-old female presenting with left ankle pain and swelling. Two days ago, she slipped on ice and snow while walking to her car, causing her left ankle to twist underneath her on the outside. She fell to the ground. After the fall, she experienced significant pain and swelling, making it difficult to walk. She has been managing symptoms with ibuprofen, ice, and elevation, which has provided minimal relief. Pain is localized to the outside of her ankle with no pain in the calf, lower leg, or knee. No bleeding reported, though there is notable swelling.

REVIEW OF SYSTEMS
No pain above the ankle. No calf pain, lower leg pain, or knee pain. No bleeding. Otherwise unremarkable.

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY
1. Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus - well-controlled
2. Hypertension

MEDICATIONS
1. Metformin - for diabetes management
2. Norvasc - for blood pressure control

ALLERGIES
Not documented.

FAMILY HISTORY
Not documented.

SOCIAL HISTORY
Patient exercises regularly and maintains good diet control for diabetes management.

PHYSICAL EXAMINATION
Neck: No bruits.
Lungs: Clear to auscultation bilaterally.
Heart: Normal; 2/6 systolic ejection murmur noted, unchanged from prior exams.
Abdomen: Benign.
Left Ankle: Tenderness over lateral malleolus and fifth metatarsal. Swelling and redness present. Pain with valgus stressing. Normal sensation and pulses distally.

RESULTS
X-ray of left ankle ordered.

ASSESSMENT AND PLAN
1. Left ankle sprain, rule out fracture - X-ray ordered to evaluate for fracture given tenderness over lateral malleolus and fifth metatarsal. Place in air splint and provide crutches. Strict non-weightbearing precautions. Start Naproxen 500 mg twice daily for pain control. Continue ice and elevation. If x-ray shows fracture, will refer to orthopedics. If no fracture, advance to partial weightbearing as tolerated.
2. Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus - Continue Metformin. Hemoglobin A1c 6.8 (excellent control). Order hemoglobin A1c and baseline labs today. Patient to maintain ophthalmology appointment scheduled for next couple of weeks. Continue diet and exercise regimen.
3. Hypertension - Blood pressure today 120/70 (well-controlled). Refill Norvasc. Continue current regimen and monitor. Contact office if any changes.
